pin_diff.note: Functionally identical EN pin (EN vs ON/OFF).
Pin 4 differs (NC/NC vs BYPASS/BYPASS): safe only if PCB leaves Pin 4 floating or decoupled via 10 nF to GND; if PCB ties NC pin directly to GND/VIN, trace cut is mandatory.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH PIN 4 (NC vs BYPASS/NR) CHECK: One device uses Pin 4 as an internal bandgap bypass/noise-reduction node while the other is NC. Verify Pin 4 is NOT tied to GND or VIN on the existing PCB before swapping; add a 10 nF bypass cap if low noise is required.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: 1 µF p.2 vs LP2985-33DBVR: 2.2 µF p.4); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.3) vs LP2985-33DBVR at 16 V rec. (16 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LP2985-33DBVR supplies up to 150 mA (p.4) compared to AP2112K-3.3TRG1 at 600 mA (p.8); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (6.5 V, p.3) than LP2985-33DBVR (16 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 6.5 V.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C) vs LP2985-33DBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2112K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and LP2985-33DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Pin 4 NC vs BYPASS difference; minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x; Vin,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 46.9 °C on AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 184 °C/W) vs 45.5 °C on LP2985-33DBVR (θJA 178.6 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.3x ratio (55 µA (p.8) vs 69 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 "6.5 V Abs Max & SOT25 Thermal Limit at 600 mA From 5 V Input" (p.3) and LP2985-33DBVR "Non-M3 OPN Ships Either Legacy Bipolar or New CMOS Silicon" (p.30). BOM decision: Choose AP2112K-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 150 mA (up to 600 mA); choose LP2985-33DBVR when input rails climb above 6 V (rated to 16 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
